item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.

**The cheapest listed option** is one **640 × 640 px square image** using the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein** model, **starting at 5 credits**. Square works for an Instagram feed post, though 640 px will look less crisp than Instagram’s usual 1080 px size.

The design would feature:
- Lots of lush potted houseplants
- A clean cream background
- Only the headline **“Bring home some green”**

**Ways to keep the cost down:** generate just one image at 640 px, with no upscale or extra variations. Since this is a still image, there’s no duration to shorten. The main caveat is that the cheapest model may not render the headline perfectly; retries would cost more.

The tool lists pricing as “from 5 credits,” so I can’t guarantee a fixed total from that listing alone. Would you like to proceed with the smallest option, or keep this as a design brief without spending credits?

turns.agent:
The request was refused because your account doesn’t have enough credits. **No image was created and no credits were spent.**

We already chose the lowest listed option: one 640 px image, starting at 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper listed generation option available here.

style.prompt: Create a polished square Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Clean warm cream background with lots of lush healthy potted houseplants arranged across the lower two thirds and along the sides: monstera, pothos, ferns, rubber plants and small leafy plants in tasteful terracotta and neutral ceramic pots. Rich green foliage, soft natural daylight, gentle shadows, inviting boutique product photography, uncluttered elegant composition. In generous clear space at the top, display a large beautifully legible dark green headline with exactly these words: "Bring home some green". Headline is the only text in the entire image. No other words, labels, prices, logos, or watermarks.
